subject: Novum Health security intake — pre-call availability & question triage
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Novum Health security intake — pre-call availability & question triage

Hi Bryce,

Thanks for the intro — excited to get the SIG/SOC2 conversation started. To make the first call productive, a few quick items so we can prep the right artifacts and SME owners: 

- Proposed call length: 45 minutes (15m intros / 20m questionnaire walk / 10m next steps)
- Availability we have: Wed 21 Jul 10:00–12:00 PT, Thu 22 Jul 09:00–11:00 PT — let me know what fits on your side.
- Preliminary asks (so we can surface evidence ahead of time):
  - Which questionnaire set do you prefer us to walk — SIG Lite or full SIG (CAIQ subset)?
  - Are you looking for SOC 2 specific artifact samples (log retention, backup reports) during this first session?
  - Any special compliance constraints (e.g., specific encryption certificate chains, air-gapped review) we should know about?

Attached is a short pre-call questionnaire template (one page) — if you can return the top-line answers, we'll pre-populate the intake in our evidence portal.

Attaching: precall-questionnaire-template.pdf

Proposed attendees from our side: me (security intake), Kimberly Park (controls owner — infra / networking), Marissa Cole (customer success — onboarding). If you want other people from Novum on the call (SRE, Legal), please add them and paste preferred time.

Next steps: please reply with a confirmed time and whether you want SIG or SOC2 focus; we'll send calendar invite and evidence link.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Security Intake Manager | Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0197

From: Bryce Holloway <bryce.holloway@novumhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novum Health security intake — pre-call availability & question triage

Hi Priyom — thanks, 45 minutes sounds good. We can do Wed 21 Jul 10:30 PT. I will invite our SecOps alias and Adam from legal to be on standby (Adam might join for procurement-y questions).

Quick responses to your preliminary asks:
- We'd like a CAIQ-first walk (SIG Lite + CAIQ). If there's time, we can tag SOC 2 artifact examples.
- For the first run, please have examples of log retention and key management (KMS/HSM) docs available. We may ask for a sample of log formats (anonymized).
- No special air-gapped constraints on the call; however, we will need proof of key custody controls for certain environments (we'll flag those during the call).

I've attached our internal inventory template (we'll populate once we see your intake).

Thanks — see you Wed 10:30 PT.

Bryce Holloway
Director, Information Security
Novum Health

Hi Bryce — great, thanks for confirming 10:30 PT on Wed the 21st. I've added a short agenda below and attached a few artifacts we typically surface for a CAIQ/SIG run-through so you know what we'll reference.

Agenda (45m):
- 5m introductions and scope alignment
- 25m CAIQ walkthrough (focus on data flows, auth, encryption, multi-tenant boundaries)
- 10m artifact review + evidence handoff plan
- 5m next steps and action owners

Prep notes / quick Qs for you before Wed: 
1) Can you confirm whether Novum needs a redacted log sample OR a schema + retention policy (we can provide both; redacted logs require an NDA and a secure transfer path).
2) For KMS: do you require HSM-backed keys for all prod environments or only regulated tenant pockets?
3) If there are platform IP allowlists, please share the egress CIDR block(s) we should match when demonstrating outbound flows.

Attachments we will upload to the intake folder prior to the call: redwood-evidence-matrix.xlsx, SOC2-brief.pdf

Portal & calendar: I've created a temporary intake folder and calendar link — both are in the invite we'll send. Portal link: https://redwood-secure.sharepoint.com/sites/NovumHealth/Intake/

If Adam from legal wants to look at our standard redaction & transfer protocol, I can loop him in after the call.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Controls Lead, Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
